notes.title: Main music by "Noriyuki Iwadare" & "Kowloonoid FM" pre-release!
notes.content:
[h1]【Main music will be composed by "Noriyuki Iwadare"】[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502454/2c2cd086d681105df6adae0297610fdc286906f5.png[/img]
[h2]Noriyuki Iwadare, a musician who has composed music for Ace Attorney, GRANDIA, and Tokyo Disney Resort, will be the main musician for this title.[/h2]
The playable demo at BitSummit Drift will include new music by Noriyuki Iwadare.
Together with the theme song composed by "DÉ DÉ MOUSE" already included in the PV, it will color the world of the Animaloid girl.
[previewyoutube=0Q8VM4zcJrU;full][/previewyoutube]


[h1]【A radio station appeared in the game! Linked with real distribution program on Youtube!】[/h1]
[previewyoutube=W6Ich-kNTF8;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Kowloonoid FM, a fictional radio station, appears in the in-game world![/h2]
In the game, it is positioned as a popular music distribution radio for the residents and is involved in the storyline. You can freely listen to it as background music in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502454/a36796ca806c152dcee02878bbded1ae8bc6f05e.jpg[/img]
[h2]The first artist to participate in the music will be chiptune artist "Rei8Bit".[/h2]

Furthermore, "Kowloonoid FM" will also appear in real life on Youtube!
The Youtube version will be a 24-hour Lo-Fi Music program.
The in-game "Kowloonoid FM" and the Youtube version of "Kowloonoid FM" will have a parallel world relationship, and although they are not the same, they will be linked so that the same music can be heard in the game, making the in-game world more familiar to the user, as if it were a real memory.
The Youtube version will play stills animated Live2D in-game + Lo-fi Music.

[*] "PANDRI-DON" Official YouTube Channel：[url=https://www.youtube.com/@pandrillon]https://www.youtube.com/@pandrillon[/url]
[*] "PANDRI-DON" X(Twitter)：[url=https://x.com/hazardkill_jp]https://x.com/hazardkill_jp[/url]
[*] BitSummit official website：[url=https://bitsummit.org/]https://bitsummit.org/[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: We will exhibit at BitSummit Drift!
notes.content:
[h2]"Animaloid Girl" will be exhibited at BitSummit Drift, the largest real event for indie games in Japan![/h2]
[previewyoutube=rQbCeTfU4Wg;full][/previewyoutube]
BitSummit, now in its 8th year, will be held at Miyakomesse, Kyoto, Japan, from July 19 to 21.

[h1]【New elements and updates to the latest playable demo】[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502454/0419d3453d0a9b3ee43cb0490bf7a9ff81218c82.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] In order to enhance the immersive experience, the storyline and presentation have been greatly brushed up.
The backgrounds, characters, and camera work are now more animated.
Please enjoy the game experience as if you were playing an anime!
[*] The game now allows you to "stroke" the girls by dragging them with the mouse, and newly recorded reaction animations have been added to the game!
[*] The new "Outing Hoodie" costume is now available for the girls to wear! Of course, she will be animated in Live2D.
[*] The language selection will be in Chinese (traditional or simplified).
The translation will be done by "flankoi" who has translated many famous indie games.
[*] The exhibition booth will be located on the 3rd floor (A-11).
[/list]


The well-known Track. series and other setting material books and goods will also be on sale.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2545200/view/4152954628608749520?l=japanese
🛒Goods are also available by mail order：[url=https://pandrillon.booth.pm/]https://pandrillon.booth.pm/[/url]

Please also subscribe to our wish list!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2545200/_/

[h1]【Animaroid Girl" and "Maid Cafe on Electric Street" have collaborated in a fluffy way!】[/h1]
At BitSummit Drift, "Animaloid Girl" collaborated with "Maid Cafe on Electric Street", a maid cafe slow life adventure set in Osaka's otaku town, Nihonbashi!
[previewyoutube=RKFLDEv_3Kw;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502454/3278ec8cbc2347d759629d6623dc6109a150d199.png[/img]
Collaboration stickers (4 types in total) will be given away at the BitSummit Drift venue only, if the following conditions are met.
[list]
[*] Follow X (Twitter) & repost the collaboration sticker announcement to receive one sticker.
『Maid Cafe on Electric Street』Official X (Twitter)：https://x.com/dreambaseinc
『Animaloid Girl』Official X (Twitter)：https://x.com/hazardkill_jp
[*] Include the hashtag of your exhibit and attach a photo of your booth at BitSummit Drift and receive one in the post.
『Maid Cafe on Electric Street』Hashtag：#電気街の喫茶店
『Animaloid Girl』Hashtag：#AnimaloidGirl
[/list]

*If you post a photo from both booths respectively, you will receive two copies, so you can complete a total of four types!

"Maid Cafe on Electric Street" will be on display at booth [B-06] for trial play.
Surugaya, Sofmap, Super Potato, and many other stores that actually exist in Nihonbashi will be present.
Let's go out on a date with the unique heroines!

A demo version is also available.
Please add "Animaloid Girl" to your wish list and wait for its release!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1789030/_/
